unit: One contract quantity unit represents 1000 PEPE; prices are USDT per 1000PEPE, not per PEPE.
selection: All candidates evaluated on the same continuous October–December 2024 stress-cost wallet before any breeding. Score = net BRL - 0.25 * maximum drawdown * initial BRL; cash is a valid baseline. Probe windows never determine breeding or compound across resets. Parent initialization ranks recoverable, compatible PEPE policies after explicit MaskablePPO weight conversion, on this same calendar. Final test remains locked pending a new prospective period; old 2025–2026 test is consumed and excluded from fitness.
notes: New isolated experiment. Old registrations, checkpoints and results remain unchanged.

SB3-Contrib MaskablePPO with the existing custom FinRL research environment. The FinRL DRLAgent factory does not implement masking. Historical PPO policy tensors are transferred only after checking every key and shape; optimizers are reset.

38 observations and 10 actions retained. Invalid state actions are masked during learning AND deterministic evaluation. Flat state cannot close/partially close/protect; open state cannot enter again. Cash is always permitted. Execution may still reject a causally valid command after a future gap, funding, zero volume or changed exchange minimum.

Training only June 2023–September 2024 excluding August 2024. All 250 candidates receive the identical continuous October–December 2024 audit each generation, with one R$1000 wallet and original daily/global loss stops. Never reset losses inside that calendar.

Rotating two-day probes are diagnostics only. Both new all-time probe PNL peaks and continuous-score champions are archived before further learning or replacement, including exact weights, hashes, wallet curve, trades, costs, calendar and lineage.

Initialization scans recoverable PEPE neural policies from the completed 250 run, partial 1000 run, immutable candidates, and G830 behavioral reconstruction. ETH G151 trees and Donchian rules cannot initialize PPO tensors. No missing historical weights are invented.

Active parent ranking is explicitly separate from the cash baseline: if all active policies lose, initialization is labeled least-bad active, not profitable. Population selection thereafter may favor cash.

Agent 0 starts with an exact tensor copy of the chosen converted parent. All 250 start from that parent with diverse learning hyperparameters and independent RNG; no silent random parameter perturbation. Later immigrants start fresh and are labeled.

Old validation Jan–Jun 2025 and old final July 2025–Aug 2026 have already been inspected. Neither is used in V3 fitness or called an independent test. Final V3 results stay pending until a new prospective calendar is separately registered and frozen.
Risk 1%, daily loss 3%, total loss 10%, leverage choice 10x/15x and stressed execution costs unchanged. No forced trading, live orders, paid AI API, credentials or network calls during training.

One thousand target generations, 250 logical agents, three worker processes in boost / one in eco, two Torch threads per worker. 48-hour active compute budget; checkpoint and pause rather than promise overnight completion.

excludedTraining.reason: Two actual mark-price minutes absent from monthly, daily and REST archives. Whole month excluded from reward/trading episodes; its valid price candles can still supply causal indicator context.

fitness: Mean(net BRL - 0.25 * maxDD * 1000) across three development quarters, minus 0.25 * max(0, -worst quarter net BRL). Independent R$1000 wallets; never sum as compounded return. Cash is valid.
adoption: Train copies; strictly higher aggregate score replaces the incumbent. Champions and rejected candidate weights/receipts are immutable.
mutation: Five LR cohorts with five seeds each. Every fifth generation, the worst five retained agents copy the frozen best and choose another registered learning rate. No other hyperparameter mutation.
diagnostic: Evaluate the same frozen founder once in three training quarters, separately from fitness. Descriptive only; no formal PBO or underfitting diagnosis. Training returns may be poor from optimization failure, costs, no signal or underfitting; regime changes confound period comparisons.
developmentStatus: All three development quarters were consumed previously. Repeated selection here remains susceptible to overfitting; this is not independent validation.
finalTest: Still locked: register a new prospective period after this selection. September 2026 was consumed by V3 and is excluded entirely.
termination: 20 total generations including inherited completed generations, then one registered validation/continuous audit of at most three frozen policies. Pause/error/disk guard. No automatic scale-up, retraining after validation or real orders.
revisionReason: User requested quarterly selection, two separate validation quarters, stability and continuous-wallet audit after V4 v1 began. V1 checkpoint and registration preserved.
validationShortlist: After generation 20, freeze the two distinct trained policies with highest development fitness from all completed V4 jobs (including inherited completed v1 jobs), plus the V3 frozen founder as control. Never choose candidates using validation results. Fewer distinct candidates are allowed.
validationSelection: Evaluate each frozen policy once with stress costs in both validation quarters. Rank lexicographically by worst quarterly excess CDI, then mean excess CDI, then lower mean maximum drawdown. The founder is a control, not a trained-policy winner.
approval: Both validation quarters must strictly beat same-calendar CDI, with no global halt and max drawdown <=20%; the continuous 15-month wallet must also beat its CDI, have no global halt and max drawdown <=20%. Failure leaves all policies unapproved. No automatic retraining after validation.
validationLimitation: These historical quarters were inspected by previous lab studies. They are held out of V4 training/fitness, but not independent untouched evidence. Selection using them consumes them; no parameter feedback or mutation follows their results.
